definition: Placebo validity. On placebo logs (every request applied whatever its logged mode, so no effect exists), with $m$ = 60 hypotheses and $r$ of them at $p$ $\le$ 0.05: P(Binomial($m$, 0.05) $\ge r$) $\ge$ 0.01, and $\le$ 1 declaration.

Null-outcome validity. 40 variants with KPI series cyclically shifted across episodes: rate of $p$ $\le$ 0.05 is $\le$ 0.075 pooled and $\le$ 0.10 in every family; $\le$ 5 variants with a declaration.
Premise in the ground truth: the knockout ground truth labels sleep $\rightarrow$ neighbour protected-slice violations true ($+$).
Support. Study 1: $\ge$ 60 tested sleep units with $\ge$ 15 logged rejections in every 120-episode slice. Study 2: $\ge$ 500 sleep units with $\ge$ 75 logged rejections.
Chain at 120 episodes: in $\ge$ 3 of 5 slices, the premise edge declared ($+$) and $\ge$ 3 chain edges declared with the ground-truth sign.
Small-slice F1: PMRT indirect F1 $\ge$ the baseline's in $\ge$ 6 of 10 60-episode and $\ge$ 3 of 5 120-episode slices, separately for correlation, Granger and Granger + BY.
Pooled discovery on all evaluation episodes: premise declared ($+$), $\ge$ 3 chain edges with the ground-truth sign, overall precision $\ge$ 0.80 and sign accuracy $\ge$ 0.90.
Sign: overall sign accuracy $\ge$ 0.90 pooled and as the mean over the 120-episode slices.

The PMRT referee (Study 2: map-driven; Study 3: edge-certified) is eligible: energy retention $\ge$ 0.90 and every guard ratio (SVR, non-protected eMBB, LL, RLF violations, each relative to accept-all) $\le$ 1.10, point estimates.

Beats the best associational map: $R^*$(PMRT) minus the largest $R^*$ of the associational maps $\ge$ 0.10, and its lower 90\,\% bound (LB90) $>$ 0, the largest map re-selected in every bootstrap resample.
Beats each associational map: one-sided paired bootstrap $p$ per distinct map signature (identical rejection rules pooled), Holm at 0.05; every hypothesis rejected.
Beats the static never-sleep rule: $R^*$ difference $>$ 0 and paired LB90 $>$ 0.
Secondary safety check: upper 90\,\% bound of the RLF ratio $\le$ 1.20; does not change the verdict label.
Referee: INVALID (K0 or K0n) $>$ NOT ELIGIBLE (Elig) $>$ PASS (D1 and D2); PARTIAL (one); FAIL
